comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Produced from an R17 casting recipe in Stockholm from the Item Shop NPC; a 17th Century Adept of Ages title (or World Clock set to 17th Century) is required to see the recipe. I believe 1/2/3/4 Chrono quest phases work; please correct me if I'm mistaken.

Production skill/Rank: R17 Casting
Ingredients: x20 Ruby + x10 Goldwork + x10 Improved Steel Sheet

Stats:

Accuracy +2
Guard +1
Ballistics +1 / fame 20000
20k total fame + Vainqueur title required to equip

It can be upgraded via Transmutation Alchemy to Vainqueur Armour EX -- its EX Effect is Increase special shot effects R10.

Source/pics: rabbilog.blog46.fc2.com/blog-entry-383.html
